h1: Killington ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Killington is the largest ski area in New England: 1,509 acres and 155 trails on its own, and 1,977 acres with 213 trails counting Pico next door. The summit reaches 4,241 feet and the base sits at 1,165, which is a lot of vertical for the east coast.
stayOverview: Killington Road is where the beds and the bars are, running down from the base area. Pico, on the same statistics page and pass, is the quieter neighbour.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The access road is long, so check how far up it you are before booking.
rentalCars: A car is the normal way here: Killington is about three hours from Boston and the access road is five miles long.
